# ETS 6 -> real Jung 3361-1M (1.1.31) System 7 (mask 0705) flash:
# request-direction TPDUs in capture order. Source: M2 live capture (issue #70,
# shared-with-windows/jung-1131-download.pcapng), app M-0004_A-A011.
# Each line: <src_ia_hex> <dst_ia_hex> <tpdu_hex>. Requests only (L_Data.req).
# The real device address is rewritten to 1105 (1.1.5) so this committed fixture
# carries NO real individual address, only the load-control + memory shape.
#
# This is the property-LSM oracle for the knx-sim System 7 calibration test: a
# sim device built from the Jung .knxprod with the property (PID-5) LSM must
# ACCEPT this exact sequence and reach Loaded on LSM 1/2/3. It pins the M2
# verdict on the wire: load control is A_PropertyValue_Write(objN, PID 5) with a
# 10-octet load event (no write to 0x0104), absolute 12-octet A_Memory_Write
# chunks over 0x4000-0x4916, the MCB verified by A_PropertyValue_Read(PID 27),
# and bare-0x380 fire-and-forget restarts. Control frames: 80 = T_Connect,
# 81 = T_Disconnect, c2/c6/... = the tool's outgoing T_ACK.
